import numpy as np

def em_gmm(X={{X}}, K={{K}}, iters={{iters}}):
    n, d = X.shape
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    mu = X[rng.choice(n, K, replace=False)]
    cov = np.array([np.eye(d) for _ in range(K)])
    pi = np.ones(K) / K
    for _ in range(iters):
        resp = np.zeros((n, K))
        for k in range(K):
            diff = X - mu[k]
            inv = np.linalg.inv(cov[k] + 1e-6*np.eye(d))
            exponent = -0.5 * np.einsum('ni,ij,nj->n', diff, inv, diff)
            norm = 1.0 / np.sqrt((2*np.pi)**d * np.linalg.det(cov[k] + 1e-6*np.eye(d)))
            resp[:, k] = pi[k] * norm * np.exp(exponent)
        resp /= resp.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12
        Nk = resp.sum(axis=0)
        pi = Nk / n
        mu = (resp.T @ X) / Nk[:, None]
        for k in range(K):
            diff = X - mu[k]
            cov[k] = (resp[:, k:k+1] * diff).T @ diff / Nk[k]
    return pi, mu, cov
